scope: Day-10 P0-A final-stage READY provenance after native OCR/CV analysis
problem: Native semantic OCR could establish provisional READY but later analysis or OCR delivery could expire/fail while the final receipt still said READY. A provider_error could be serialized as OCR completed.
changes: The native observer downgrades provisional READY to PARTIAL, clears semantic success/frame/predicate markers when downstream CV or OCR completion fails, and reports OCR provider_error as UNAVAILABLE.
The native Web bridge rejects READY whose final CV/OCR source receipts are missing, incomplete, attributed to another frame, or explicitly expired.
Test fixtures for ordering, lease rotation and publication cancellation now carry consistent completed native source receipts.
